tooltip.atzen.river_rod: Soft and forgiving (4 kg lift, very supple), a little faster.
tooltip.atzen.iron_rod: Stiff and strong: pumps with 7 kg but passes every jolt on.
tooltip.atzen.carbon_rod: The best rod: 9 kg of lift and still supple, 10% faster.
tooltip.atzen.bamboo_rod: Beginner: very soft and sensitive, casts 1–15 g, for fish up to 3 kg. Bears only 5 kg.
tooltip.atzen.spinning_rod: Versatile for lures: casts 5–40 g far, sensitive, for perch, trout, pike up to 10 kg.
tooltip.atzen.carp_rod: For bottom rigs and long runs: casts 15–120 g furthest, bears 17 kg, little feel.
tooltip.atzen.fly_rod: With fly reel and fly long casts, the most sensitive rod, for trout and grayling.
tooltip.atzen.big_game_rod: For wels, sturgeon and bosses: bears 42 kg and pumps with 14 kg, but heavy, stiff and hardly feels small fish.
tooltip.atzen.copper_reel: Beginner: 120 m, 5 kg. Forgiving: slack costs less hook hold.
tooltip.atzen.diamond_reel: 200 m, 9 kg. Fine drag: jolts from head shakes and jumps arrive much weaker.
tooltip.atzen.baitcaster_reel: Very fast (4 m/s), 110 m. Careful: a run against a loose drag (≤ 3) tangles the spool.
tooltip.atzen.multiplier_reel: For big fish: 350 m and 15 kg power gear, but slow.
tooltip.atzen.fly_reel: Only 90 m, but pumping pulls 60% harder; fish under 3 kg fight weaker.
tooltip.atzen.echo_reel: 180 m, 8 kg. Hears the fish: every action is announced a second earlier.
tooltip.atzen.tide_reel: 220 m, 9 kg. Sea fish never get their breath back on the hook.
tooltip.atzen.netherite_reel: 300 m, 14 kg. Self-limiting drag: never holds more than 90% of the breaking load.
tooltip.atzen.ancient_reel: Boss reward. 320 m, 13 kg. Anchor: runs take 35% less line.
tooltip.atzen.reed_reel: Boss reward. Fast, 180 m. Jumps never throw the hook while the rod stays down.
tooltip.atzen.current_reel: Boss reward. 280 m, 12 kg. Takes in line on its own while the fish rests.
tooltip.atzen.deep_reel: Boss reward. 300 m, 12 kg, fast. The fish tires 25% faster and shows earlier what it will do.
tooltip.atzen.shallow_spool: For thin line: 15% longer casts, 30% less line.
tooltip.atzen.light_spool: For light baits: 20% longer casts, even more below 10 g; 15% less force.
tooltip.atzen.reinforced_spool: 20% more force, prevents baitcaster backlash, a little slower.
tooltip.atzen.nylon_line: Breaking load 7 kg. Stretches and soaks up jolts, forgives a lot.
tooltip.atzen.braided_line: Breaking load 14 kg, hardly any stretch, direct. Frays fast on snags.
tooltip.atzen.carbon_line: The best line: 20 kg breaking load, some stretch, very abrasion resistant.
tooltip.atzen.fluoro_leader: Nearly invisible under water: shy fish bite better. Tough on snags.
tooltip.atzen.steel_leader: Teeth cannot bite through (pike, zander, barracuda …), but shy fish see it.
tooltip.atzen.small_single_hook: For small fish and cautious biters. Bends open above 4 kg.
tooltip.atzen.single_hook: The all-rounder (default without a hook). Holds 9 kg.
tooltip.atzen.large_single_hook: For big fish: holds 18 kg, scares small fish off.
tooltip.atzen.treble_hook: For lures: sets firmer (+15), worse with natural baits.
tooltip.atzen.barbless_hook: Barbless: gentle on the fish, but falls out easier on a slack line.
tooltip.atzen.carp_hook: With boilie, corn or current bait it sets firmer (+20). Holds 14 kg.
tooltip.atzen.offset_hook: With a soft lure it sets firmer (+20) and snags half as often.
tooltip.atzen.circle_hook: Sets itself: strike timing does not matter. Large and strong (16 kg).
tooltip.atzen.carbon_fiber: From a coal block in a blast furnace. For the carbon rod and line.
tooltip.atzen.worm_bait: Natural bait for almost all: coarse fish, trout, eel, bottom fish.
tooltip.atzen.maggot_bait: Natural bait: coarse fish and trout love them.
tooltip.atzen.corn_bait: Natural bait for coarse fish only, carp above all.
tooltip.atzen.bread_bait: Natural bait for coarse fish, chub and rudd above all.
tooltip.atzen.boilie_bait: Selective: coarse fish only, but mostly big carp.
tooltip.atzen.baitfish_bait: For predators in fresh and salt water, rather big ones. Wels and pike above all.
tooltip.atzen.fish_strip_bait: For predators and bottom fish at sea and in rivers.
tooltip.atzen.larva_bait: For trout and grayling, coarse fish too.
tooltip.atzen.shrimp_bait: Sea bait for bottom fish and predators.
tooltip.atzen.glow_bait: Draws every fish, at night most of all. Runs pull 20% weaker.
tooltip.atzen.hearty_bait: Draws almost every fish. Fish tire 25% faster, but 12% more strain.
tooltip.atzen.spinner: Lure for perch, asp, trout and pike. Wears down.
tooltip.atzen.spoon: Lure for predators in fresh and salt water.
tooltip.atzen.wobbler: Lure for predators, tends to bring big ones.
tooltip.atzen.soft_lure: Lure, zander love it. Wears out fast.
tooltip.atzen.popper: Surface lure for the sea: sea bass, barracuda. Hooked fish jump more.
tooltip.atzen.jig: Lure for the bottom and open sea, cod and saithe above all.
tooltip.atzen.streamer: Fly for trout and predators. Best with a fly reel.
tooltip.atzen.dry_fly: For trout and grayling. Needs a fly reel, otherwise half as good.
tooltip.atzen.nymph: Sub-surface fly for trout and grayling. Best with a fly reel.
tooltip.atzen.ancient_bait: Boss bait: at night in a lake or swamp at least 5 blocks deep, it calls the Old One of the Deep.
tooltip.atzen.reed_king_lure: Boss lure: in a swamp in the rain or at dusk and dawn, it draws the Reed King.
tooltip.atzen.current_bait: Boss bait: by day in a river at least 4 blocks deep, it wakes the Black Sturgeon.
tooltip.atzen.deep_light_bait: Boss bait: in hidden water below y 0, out of sight of the sky, the Deep Warden appears.
tooltip.atzen.ancient_barbel: Trophy of the Old One of the Deep. For the Reel of the Old One.
tooltip.atzen.reed_crown: Trophy of the Reed King. For the Reed Crown Reel.
tooltip.atzen.sturgeon_plate: Trophy of the Black Sturgeon. For the Current Reel.
tooltip.atzen.warden_heart: Trophy of the Deep Warden. For the Deep Heart Reel.
tooltip.atzen.steady_line_tome: Use with a rod in the other hand: Steady Line +1 (+8% breaking load).
tooltip.atzen.reel_power_tome: Use with a rod in the other hand: Reel Power +1 (+8% retrieve and force).
tooltip.atzen.calm_waters_tome: Use with a rod in the other hand: Calm Waters +1 (runs 12% weaker).

message.atzen.help: Atzen: cast, right-click at a bite (good timing sets the hook firmer). In the fight: R reels, G lifts the rod (pumping), arrow up/down sets the drag, arrow left/right steers, and when the fish is close and worn out, right-click to land it. Drop reel, line and bait onto the rod in your inventory. /atzen practice [fish|boss] starts a no-loot training, /atzen cancel stops, C toggles the cinematic camera. Keys are configurable.
message.atzen.controls_hint: First fight! %1$s reel · %2$s lift (pump) · %3$s/%4$s steer · %5$s/%6$s drag · close and worn out: right-click to land · %7$s cancel · %8$s cinematic camera. The bar above the hotbar tells you what to do.
